title: Trump Media pulls back from crypto, scraps Crypto.com's CRO token treasury deal
summary: The Truth Social parent company is refocusing on media and its pending merger with a fusion energy firm, as the digital asset treasury boom has lost its steam.

title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin director Justin Mateen buys nearly $2 million of ABTC stock
summary: Mateen purchased more than 306,000 shares across two days following the company's quarterly earnings, lifting his stake to more than 492,000 shares.

title: U.S. widens Iran crypto crackdown with sanctions on two exchanges
summary: The Treasury's OFAC targeted Shelbit and Aban Tether as Washington continues its effort to cut Tehran's access to crypto and foreign currency.

title: BitMEX sale collapsed as buyers balked at founder ownership and shrinking business
summary: Potential buyers, including Exodus, passed on BitMEX amid concerns over founder ownership and its shrinking business, according to a source familiar.

title: Bybit sues North Korea and Lazarus Group over $1.5 billion hack, secures asset freeze
summary: The exchange has secured a preliminary injunction freezing stolen assets.
